Bare, unprotected processor input/output BL (PC3), tested as an input. Used for emergency startup of the built-in bootloader. Connector or jumper location depends on ECU family.

string-array.name: diag_help_outputs_t
string-array.item: Ignition output 1. Enable it and the transistor conducts to ground. On SECU-3 Lite with built-in coil drivers, the checkbox works in reverse.
Ignition output 2. Enable it and the transistor conducts to ground. On SECU-3 Lite with built-in coil drivers, the checkbox works in reverse.
Ignition output 3. Enable it and the transistor conducts to ground.
Ignition output 4. Enable it and the transistor conducts to ground.
IE output. When enabled, its transistor passes current from 12 V to the output. I/O reassignment and inversion settings do not change diagnostic output control.
FE output. When enabled, its transistor passes current from 12 V to the output. I/O reassignment and inversion settings do not change diagnostic output control.
ECF output for controlling the cooling fan or idle-air valve (PWM).
CE output for controlling the Check Engine lamp.
Starter-blocking output (starter relay). When enabled, the transistor conducts to ground.
ADD_IO1 output for controlling auxiliary devices.
ADD_IO2 output for controlling auxiliary devices.

Input/output pin BL_I (PC3), a processor pin without a buffer transistor. It is connected to the stepper controller DIR signal and optionally a transistor gate; the transistor output is available at connector pin SM_AO1.

Input/output pin DE_I (PC2), a processor pin without a buffer transistor. It is connected to the stepper controller STEP signal and optionally a transistor gate; the transistor output is available at connector pin SM_AO2.
